changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7546-chart-series-keys-declared.md`

- names `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` → `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Every one of the six is read by `normalizeSeries` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `normalizeChartSchema.ts:242-255`) and does real work in `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` — `label` names the legend entry, `variant === 'comparison'` selects the muted overlay, `opacity` / `dashArray` set stroke and fill, `stack` becomes Recharts' `stackId`, `yAxis` binds the secondary axis. Any consumer of the parse output — `objectui check` / `objectui validate` via `safeValidateSchema`, a JSON schema derived from the mirror, or any pipeline that keeps `parse()`'s result — lost them outright.

### `.changeset/7694-chart-series-chart-type-alias-refusal.md`

- names `normalizeChartSchema.ts` → `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts` — edited by this change

  > `chartType` is the renderer's INTERNAL spelling of `type`: the first limb of `normalizeSeries`' `str(raw.chartType) ?? str(raw.type)` (`@object-ui/plugin-charts`, `normalizeChartSchema.ts`), written by the internal-shape producers that hand `dataKey`-shaped arrays straight to `ChartRenderer` (`ObjectChart`, `DatasetWidget`; `core/utils/chart-presentation` translates authored `type` *into* it) and by nothing an author writes. Re-measured at implementation time, series-level, with lit controls (`dataKey` / `name` / `type` / `color`): docs 0, fixtures 0, designer inputs 0 (the `chart` registration's `series` is one `code` input), src literals 0, tests 9 — every one an internal-shape array that never meets this mirror. Limb ablation over 304 files / 5817 tests: deleting `str(raw.chartType) ??` left all green; deleting the `?? str(raw.type)` sibling went 2 red.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `383a34f52` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1539 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2125 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36186020507)

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5653746070a0b5d18dc6d8d7fc2f3cb248a55bd9`

Read: card objectui#10691 (body, triage `5837770949`, claim `5837854767`; the `os-dev-report` was not used as evidence), PR objectui#10716 body and file list, the diff of `refs/review/pr-10716` against merge-base `383a34f529f6c60d3da4c1b76b502635f89a8b8d` (two commits: `711767082` the fix, `565374607` a merge of `origin/main`), the head blobs of both implementation files, the pin, `index.tsx`, `package.json`, `ChartRenderer.tsx`, `ObjectChart.tsx`/`types.ts` (grep), `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx`, `.changeset/config.json`, changesets `7546` and `7694`, AGENTS.md 版本号策略 (lines 267-273) and the changeset-presence rule (line 168), and `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`'s `ChartConfig.yAxis`. The shared tree `/home/user/objectui` has no `node_modules`; the spec was read, read-only, from the same version installed under `objectui-issue-10694/node_modules/.pnpm/@objectstack+spec@17.4.0_ai@7.0.65_zod@4.4.3_` (`dist/ui/index.js:3088`: `yAxis: z.array(ChartAxisSchema).optional()`, uncapped). No worktree was checked out or edited. Zero GitHub writes.

### ① Derived judgments

Binding text. Triage `5837770949`: 「say so, ⛔ don't narrow. objectui does not own the `yAxis` face: the spec declares it uncapped, and a narrower objectui mirror would be a second spelling. So an entry past the second gets a visible note naming `yAxis[N]` through the note channel PR objectui#10647 / PR objectui#10686 use, and its series binding is stated. Pin a three-entry chart drawing the note, with the two-entry chart as the control.」 Claim limits: no narrowing of the accepted count; no objectui mirror of the spec face; no refusal; no new published prop; not `ObjectChart.tsx`'s fetch; no date-formatting locale read.

1. `placeYAxes` gains `undrawn` — RIGHT. `packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts:449-463` declares `YAxisUndrawnNote { index; boundTo: ValueAxisSlot }`; `:472-473` adds `undrawn: YAxisUndrawnNote[]` to `YAxisPlacement`; `:542-545` fills it from `(yAxes ?? []).slice(entries.length)` with `index: entries.length + offset, boundTo: 'right'`, where `entries` is still `slice(0, 2)` (`:516`). With 0, 1 or 2 entries the slice is empty, so `undrawn` is `[]` (pinned, test `:183-187`). The accepted count does not move: the normalizer still maps every entry into `yAxes` (`:626-629`), no zod or TS mirror is added, and no refusal path is added. Inside the triage's "say so, don't narrow".

2. The normalizer's derived-series binding reads the placement — RIGHT and behaviour-preserving. `:670` builds `slotOfEntry = [...placement.slotOf, ...placement.undrawn.map(boundTo)]` and `:672` reads `slotOfEntry[i]`, replacing the base's `placement.slotOf[i] ?? 'right'`. For indices 0-1 the value is `slotOf[i]`; for indices 2 and up it is `'right'`, the same answer the base's fallback gave; `slotOfEntry` covers exactly `yAxes.length` indices, so no index reads `undefined`. The pin ties the two (`test:173-181`). The card's own statement "a series derived from it plots against the right-hand axis" stays true and is now stated by the note.

3. The note — RIGHT, and its binding statement is TRUE on every family it draws on. `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx:698-729` `yAxisUndrawnNotes` returns `null` when `undrawn` is empty (`:703`) and otherwise one `p` element with `role="note" data-chart-note="y-axis-undrawn"` per entry (`:710`), joined after the `y-axis-position` notes into the same `yPositionNote` (`:1777-1780`), which reaches `ChartFootnote` on the scatter (`:2461`), combo (`:2584`) and bar/line/area/horizontal-bar (`:2682`) branches. `ChartFootnote` (`:839-847`) puts the note in a `div.mt-1.shrink-0` after the plot, so "under the plot" is true. Binding check, per family, at the head: an `undrawn` entry exists only with three or more entries, so both slots are filled (`placeYAxes` rules 2-4 give distinct slots) and `hasDualAxis` is true (`:1770`); the derived series carries `yAxis: 'right'` (normalizer `:672-678`, `i` at least 2 so the key is always emitted); on bar, line and area the mark binds `yAxisId: 'right'` (`:2806-2807`) to the `YAxis` element with `yAxisId="right" orientation="right"` (`:2757-2765`); on horizontal-bar it binds `xAxisId: 'right'` (`:2807`) to the `XAxis` element with `xAxisId="right" orientation="top"` (`:2714`); on combo `yAxisId` is `s.yAxis` = `'right'` (`:2624-2628`) on the right `YAxis` element (`:2606`). The note's side comes from `valueAxisSide(note.boundTo, valueAxesRunAcross)` (`:608-611`: right, or top on horizontal-bar) and `against = placement[note.boundTo]` (`:708`) names the entry drawn in that slot, which is `yAxis[0]` when the first entry names `right` (pinned, `test:126-137`). The drawing condition "the chart declares neither `series` nor `categories`" matches the normalizer: derivation fires on `!series?.length` (`:666`) where `series` comes from `schema.series`, else `schema.categories` (`:641-651`). Fringe, not a defect: an empty `series: []` or a list `normalizeSeries` rejects wholesale also derives, and the note's conditional then under-claims; it never states a false binding. Both `valueAxesRunAcross` arguments are `chartType === 'horizontal-bar'` (normalizer `:667`, renderer `:1762-1763`), so the two calls agree.

4. `ChartRenderer` passes every entry through (`packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.tsx:247` `yAxes={props.spec.yAxes}`), so the renderer's `placeYAxes` sees the third entry. No `ObjectChart.tsx` edit, no locale read: confirmed by the file list (five files) and the diff.

5. Charts that must be byte-identical — HOLDS by construction, and the pin's controls cover it at the note level. With two or fewer entries `yAxisUndrawnNotes` returns `null` and `joinNotes` (`:736-740`) returns `present[0] ?? null`, exactly what the base's bare `yAxisPositionNotes(...)` returned; `yPositionNote` is consumed only by the three cartesian branches (`:2461`, `:2584`, `:2682`), so pie, donut, funnel, radar, treemap and sankey are untouched. On scatter the placement is built from `yAxes?.slice(0, 1)` (`:1763`), so `undrawn` is always empty there. Controls: two entries on five families assert no `role=note` at all (`test:156-159`), a two-entry conflict asserts exactly `['y-axis-position']` (`:161-165`), pie with three entries asserts none (`:167-170`). This is a note-kind proxy rather than a byte snapshot; judged adequate given the `joinNotes` contract read above.

6. Scatter left unchanged — INSIDE the card as bounded, and reported. The card's Fact binds on `placeYAxes`'s `slice(0, 2)` and the probe was a bar; the triage lands the fix in `placeYAxes`. On scatter the renderer places only the first entry, so the silent threshold is "past the first", a different rule, and a note naming `yAxis[2]` while `yAxis[1]` stayed silent would be a half-answer. The PR's Acceptance notes and the changeset's last sentence both say scatter renders as before, and the report files it with dedupe words. Flag for the seat: read literally, the triage sentence "an entry past the second gets a visible note" is not met on a scatter with three entries and authored `series`; that gap belongs to a scatter card, not to this diff. The scatter no-series path is not touched by the diff and was not verified here.

7. Missing asks: none on the two-slot families. The three-entry note is pinned on bar, line, area, combo and horizontal-bar with the two-entry control (`test:94-114`, `:156-159`); the binding is stated; four entries give two notes in order (`:116-124`); the position note is kept beside the new one (`:139-146`); authored `series` still gets the note (`:148-153`).

8. Done but not asked: only docblock prose — `AdvancedChartImplProps.yAxes` (`:327-329`) and `placeYAxes`'s comment (`normalizeChartSchema.ts:502-508`). Every touched file is inside the claim's file surface.

9. Existing pins edited or deleted: none. The diff adds one test file and edits no test. `ChartRenderer.yAxisPosition-10654.test.tsx` names `placeYAxes` only in a comment (`:25`) and asserts no whole placement object, so the added `undrawn` key weakens no guard.

10. New pins can fail. Negative leg: at the merge-base `git grep` finds 0 occurrences of `y-axis-undrawn` under `packages/plugin-charts/src`, so every `toHaveLength(1)` row fails there; `placement.undrawn` is `undefined` at base, so `test:176` throws and `test:185` fails. Lit control: item 5. Cross-check of the stated binding: `topTick(slotSide)` at least 90 and below 1000 (`test:112-113`, `:135`) reads the tick labels of the axis the note names, so a `boundTo` flipped to `'left'` would move `units` onto the left axis and drop the right axis's top tick to `cost`'s range, going red. CI's eight test shards passed at the head, which is the run relied on here; the PR body's local readings were not used as evidence.

11. Hard-coded English wording follows the `x-axis-position` / `y-axis-position` channel, which carries no i18n key; the `yAxis[N]` index is the normalized index, the same convention those notes use. Consistent, not a defect.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/10691-third-yaxis-note.md`: `'@object-ui/plugin-charts': patch`. RIGHT. AGENTS.md line 168: a `src/` edit in a fixed-group package must add a changeset with a normal bump; `@object-ui/plugin-charts` is in the single fixed group of 40 (`.changeset/config.json`). Lines 269-271: minor/patch evolve independently, never `major`, breaking changes take `minor`. Nothing breaks: `packages/plugin-charts/src/index.tsx:14-38` is unchanged and exports only `ChartRenderer`, `ChartBarRenderer`, `ObjectChart`, `ObjectChartBlock`, `ObjectChartProps`, `BarChartSchema`, `normalizeChartSchema`, `NormalizedChartSchema` and `chartComponents`; `NormalizedChartSchema` (`normalizeChartSchema.ts:240-260`) has no placement member; `YAxisPlacement` and `YAxisUndrawnNote` are returned only by `placeYAxes`, which no index-exported module references (grep of `ObjectChart.tsx`, `ChartRenderer.tsx`, `types.ts`, `index.tsx`: none); `package.json` `exports` (`.` only) is not in the diff.
